stories.title: 76ers take down defending champion Knicks in season opener
LeBron moonlights at center, helps limit Towns in winning debut for Sixers
stories.summary: LeBron James opened his 24th season with 14 points, nine rebounds and seven assists and even had a defensive impact as a center in his Sixers debut.

stories.title: Thunder have Holmgren's back -- in scuffle, and in wake of redemptive season opener
stories.summary: The scrap early in the second quarter of Tuesday night's season opener offered some symbolism for Chet Holmgren and his Thunder teammates. Holmgren landed with a thud. As he got back to his feet, his teammates had his back.

stories.title: NFLPA calls for 'full investigation' into Eagles QB Hurts' medical care
stories.summary: After NFL chief medical officer Allen Sills staunchly defended the process involving Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts and his blood clot issue Tuesday, the NFLPA issued a statement calling for a "full investigation" into his medical care.

stories.title: Wembanyama starts 0-for-12 in career-worst shooting night: 'Might be overthinking it'
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama didn't record his first bucket until the end of the third quarter and shot a career-worst 8% from the field as the Thunder got their revenge on the Spurs in Tuesday's Western Conference finals rematch.
